tables.caption: Test set comparison of enhanced neural models with state-of-the-art single model baselines across six benchmark NLP tasks. The performance metric varies across tasks -- accuracy for SNLI and SST-5; F for SQuAD, SRL and NER; average F for Coref. Due to the small test sizes for NER and SST-5, we report the mean and standard deviation across five runs with different random seeds. The "increase" column lists both the absolute and relative improvements over our baseline.
